message: The other day, I was rummaging through our go-bags, and I found a pack of gummy bears, a half-eaten granola bar, and a collection of mismatched socks. 😂 I had to laugh at myself—clearly, I’m a bit more prepared for a snack attack than an emergency! But it reminded me that it’s important to check in on our supplies regularly. I’ve made a note to update our bags with some real essentials. What’s a funny thing you’ve found in your emergency kit?
